input: Why did successful visits drop between Oct 1–7 and Oct 8–14, 2025?
expected_output: Successful visits fell from 18 to 15 (−3). The entire drop is on charger CH-001: CH-002 had no successful visits in either week, because every one of its visits failed with ConnectorLockFailure. On CH-001, visits fell from 18 to 16 and one visit failed. First attempt success on CH-001 fell from 17 of 18 visits to 11 of 16, and 4 of its 5 first-attempt failures recovered as troubled successes.

input: Was the drop in successful visits between Oct 1–7 and Oct 8–14, 2025 concentrated on specific chargers or spread across the network?
expected_output: Concentrated: the entire drop of 3 successful visits (18 → 15) is on charger CH-001. CH-002 had 0 successful visits in both weeks, so it did not contribute to the change.

input: Was the drop in successful visits between Oct 1–7 and Oct 8–14, 2025 driven by fewer visits or by a lower success rate?
expected_output: Mostly fewer visits. On CH-001, where the whole drop occurred, visits fell from 18 to 16 and the visit success rate from 100% to 93.75% (1 failed visit): fewer visits explain about two thirds of the drop and the lower success rate about one third. The network-wide success rate (26.09% → 22.73%) is dominated by CH-002, which failed all 101 of its visits.
